_comment: Instant - Destroy this: Prevent the next 1 arcane damage that would be dealt to you this turn; if you've boosted this turn, INSTEAD prevent the next 2. Modeled as an ACTIVATE with a destroy-this cost and a CONDITIONAL_EFFECT on the BOOSTED flag (then PREVENT_DAMAGE 2, else 1). Prior JSON gated the whole ability on BOOSTED (no prevention at all when not boosted), used an unrecognized 'additional_effects' key, and only SET_FLAG (which nothing consumed).
